title: ZuCrypt Keyless
features:
Sawah Indo Script - ZuCrypt Keyless
Auto Farm | Auto Buy Seeds | Auto Harvest | Auto Sell | Multi-Area Support | NPC Teleport | Anti AFK

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FEATURES
Auto Farm
Automatically sells all crops, buys seeds when stock runs out, harvests ready crops, and plants new seeds — all in one cycle. Supports multi-area selection with adjustable cycle delay.
Buy & Sell
Manually buy any seed type with a custom amount. Sell all harvested crops instantly in one click.
Teleport
Teleport to NPCs (Seed, Merchant, Tools, Palm Oil Trader), farm areas, safe zones, and the shower area with one click.
Anti AFK
Runs silently in the background. Prevents kick by simulating input when the player goes idle.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
